taken: censusSystem for real stars. First 700 stars: Sol and its Neighborhood, the far home galaxy, two galaxies in each of the six regions, and two deep worlds. Then every real star with planets under a ring that caps (the whole home galaxy and every galaxy of the three inner regions, both layers of stars) was read by the legacy game, and kept when the ring cut the tier of one of its worlds, or when it held an outcome of type, band and life or a biome met fewer than 3 times so far (or fewer times than the seeded census of 100,000 worlds met it, when that is under 3). The stars were listed and proven by this game's star generation and resolver; the legacy game was given each star's seed and place. An addressed line also holds the world's type, orbit, the descent's biome, the life and band, the card's Life and civilisation rows, its title and its spectral class with st.gal unset. One case a star: the count of its planets and the digest of its lines. ring: what the widening read, and every world among it whose tier the ring cut, by the tier it was cut to. hits: how many worlds hit each entry of each table. Read through the legacy game's own functions, cut from its script by tools/census-legacy.mjs and run with new Function: mulberry32, hashInt, clamp, TAU, SYL, properName, the WorldConfig constants, starClass, SOL_PLANETS, planetParams, genRocks, _systemFor, climateBand, biosphere, ERAS, civilization, the first statements of planetDescriptor (the survey stream, band, biosphere, civilization), its civilisation rows, its designation statements and its epithet statements, BIOME_SETS, biomeFor, biomeComposition, descentTierFromPct, DESCENT_TIERS, descentFor, rarityRoll, GRADE_TIERS, TIER_MAX, SPECTRA, spectral, REGIONS, regionAt, RING_SPECTRUM, ASC_RING_R, gradeCapAt, _specDomOf, _clampSpectral, ringDesignation, DEPOSIT_PROFILES, RARE_VEIN, depositsFor, BIOME_VEIN, biomeVeinFor, COSMIC_FOUND, COSMIC_BREAK, cosmicVeinFor, exVeinFor, reserveFor, MOON_TYPES, roman, SOL_MOONS, moonDescriptor. Supplied by the recorder: st ({sys: the system being read; gal: unset for a seeded world, so no depth boost and no ring cap, and the galaxy of the address for an addressed world}), moonThumb (returns null), and for a first landing _waveOffs (empty), _descWx (no storm), descentBonus and _equipBonus (0).
